posts.description: Create Chord progressions by your current or desired mood. You can create melodies in every scale out there. After you generate melodies and chords..you can tweak notes right away in your browser and hear how they sound instantly. As a final touch, you can export generated melodies into MIDI file and use them in your choice of Digital Audio Workstation aka DAW.

posts.name: Magic Event Live Pro
posts.tagline: Control live visuals and lighting with body gestures
posts.description: A macOS tool that turns camera-detected hand and body poses into control signals for live production. Send OSC to Resolume or TouchDesigner, output Art-Net or sACN for lighting, and use FreeD for camera and virtual-production workflows. Recognition runs locally, supports multiple cameras, custom pose references, zones, thresholds, and ON/OFF timing for reliable cues. First-user promo: LTLENH3TJ4JM (single-use macOS App Store code). Reply after redeeming so others know it has been used.

posts.name: Testovex
posts.tagline: No-code, AI test automation for enterprise QA
posts.description: Testovex is an Automation Center of Excellence (ACOE) platform that lets enterprise QA teams build, manage, and run end-to-end tests — without writing code.

posts.name: Blazly Lead Engine
posts.tagline: Your 24/7 AI Lead Generation & Conversion Engine
posts.description: Turn your website into a 24/7 AI sales engine. Blazly Lead Engine lets you build an AI chatbot trained on your business, answer customer questions instantly, qualify leads, capture contact details, manage pipelines, automate follow-ups, and convert more visitors into customers—all without writing code.

posts.name: pirch
posts.tagline: the job hunter that checks every listing is real
posts.description: you're not a keyword. tell pirch who you are and it hunts: a few genuinely-matched jobs, each opened and confirmed live and accepting applicants within the last 72 hours, with a why and a written cover letter. it never auto-applies — you stay in control. new since our first launch: free public verified-jobs pages, a free resume guide, and a public MCP server so AI agents can search verified jobs too (pirchjobs.com/mcp). first hunt's free.

posts.name: Ratedeed
posts.tagline: Home projects made simple with escrow payments
posts.description: Ratedeed is the trusted marketplace for finding and hiring verified local contractors. Compare reviews, get quotes, and book home improvement projects with secure escrow payments.

posts.name: AssetLoom
posts.tagline: Total Control Over Every IT Asset
posts.description: AssetLoom is an IT asset operations platform that gives full control over IT assets with unified lifecycle management and automation.

posts.name: DialMCP
posts.tagline: Your agent can now make phone calls
posts.description: DialMCP is a hosted MCP server that lets Claude, Codex, Gamut and any MCP-enabled agent place real phone calls on your behalf — from your own verified number, with transcripts, recordings, and guardrails built in.

posts.name: Wallop
posts.tagline: Budgeting with a pig who guilt-trips you into saving
posts.description: Every budgeting app tells you the numbers. Wallop makes you care about them - a pig mascot who reacts to every deposit and every withdrawal, so your emergency fund stops being an abstract balance and starts being something you don't want to let down. Weirdly, that's what makes people actually stick to their goals.

posts.name: S2Q
posts.tagline: No subscription Stripe to QuickBooks Sync
posts.description: Per-transaction sync of Stripe charges, refunds, fees, and payouts into QuickBooks Online. AI explains every entry so your books match your bank. Pay per transaction, no subscription. USD only.

posts.name: Toldari
posts.tagline: Stay close to your people. Private, no feed, no datamining.
posts.description: Toldari is a private, local-first app for staying close to the people who matter. Keep the easy-to-forget things about each person (interests, dates, follow-ups) and get a gentle nudge when it's been too long. No feed, no metrics, no account. Everything lives on your device; we can't read your data, so there's nothing to mine or sell. Free to download, every core feature included for 14 days, then a one-time $4.99 unlocks it forever. Optional Premium adds encrypted backup and private sharing.

posts.name: Cadence
posts.tagline: A calm weekly planner for Mac and iPhone
posts.description: Cadence is a calm weekly planner that keeps the whole week visible. Capture tasks in an inbox, place them on the right day, add duration or reminders, and drag unfinished work forward when plans change. Mac and iPhone stay in sync through your own iCloud account. There is no account, team workspace or heavyweight project system: just the week, the work and a clearer next step.

posts.name: Thrivez
posts.tagline: The All-in-One Creator Workspace
posts.description: Thrivez is the all-in-one creator workspace — build income your way by selling, freelancing, teaching, and earning, all from one platform with a 24/7 AI mentor. Here you'll find practical tips and tool walkthroughs to help you get the most out of Thrivez. Thrivez | Creator Workspace 🚀 • Sell merch, & courses • Answer Surveys. Earn Money • 2k+ cashback brands • Find Jobs & Apply • 24/7 AI mentor included

posts.name: StreamingBeam
posts.tagline: Find where anything streams — AI picks, alerts, and more
posts.description: StreamingBeam solves streaming's #1 frustration — not knowing which service has what you want to watch. Search any title and instantly see every platform carrying it. Filter to just your services. Browse by mood, genre, or decade. Get AI picks, Leaving Soon alerts, watchlist notifications, and a Cost Calculator. Free on Google Play + App Store. Use code BEAMON for 7 days free Premium.

posts.name: Lacuna
posts.tagline: The stuff school skipped, for $1 a topic
posts.description: Practical primers on what school skipped — money, contracts, your own habits, and more. Every topic is $1, part 1 always free.

posts.name: PrivacyStage
posts.tagline: One-click privacy protection for screen sharing on Mac
posts.description: PrivacyStage secures your Mac screen sharing with one click! Features: Desktop & Notification Shields: Hide desktop icons and silence alerts. Window Hider: Easily hide multiple private windows from your audience. Privacy Mask: On-device AI blurs sensitive data in real-time. Panic Hotkey: Hit one button to instantly activate all shields and hide everything! 100% on-device processing. Never leak private info again!

posts.name: SongClash
posts.tagline: Free multiplayer music guessing game
posts.description: SongClash is a free multiplayer music quiz. Guess the song as fast as possible, challenge your friends in real time, climb the leaderboard, and break speed records across hundreds of playlists.

posts.name: Diagnosica
posts.tagline: Practise a whole patient case, from history to scorecard
posts.description: Diagnosica is a clinical simulator that runs a whole case, not a question about one. You take the history from a video patient by voice or text, order labs and view real imaging, commit to a diagnosis and management plan, then get a scorecard on four safety-weighted competencies. Question banks test recall of a case someone else worked up. Mannequin sim needs a room, a booking and a faculty slot. This is the reasoning in between. 45 cases, 12 specialties, doctor-reviewed. One free, no signup.

posts.name: LEO Soul by Kadropic Labs
posts.tagline: Give Your AI Agent a Soul - A Way For Proper Judgement
posts.description: LEO Soul is a metacognitive reliability layer for LLM agents, the grown up alternative to prompt only guardrails, it measures its own uncertainty, teaches itself in the background with online learning algorithm, follows its own genuine curiosity to close knowledge gaps, resists being talked out of the right answer, cuts hallucinations, and decides when to answer, ask, confirm, or refuse, a self learning agent brain runs fully on math, works with any model By Kadropic Labs.

posts.name: StrataMetriq Architecture Intelligence
posts.tagline: Visual architecture graphs & pre-deployment safety in VS Cod
posts.description: StrataMetriq is an enterprise DevSecOps tool that transforms technical debt into interactive graphs. Trace full-stack API flows natively in VS Code and enforce a 13-point pre-deployment safety audit before your code ever hits production.

posts.name: PersonaHaven
posts.tagline: Free personality tests with practical next steps
posts.description: PersonaHaven is a free self-reflection platform for adults that goes beyond personality-test scores. It combines clear reports on patterns, strengths, and blind spots with practical next steps, Growth Paths, real-life Scenario Labs, Quick Tools, and useful guides. Instead of leaving users with a label, PersonaHaven helps them understand what the result means and apply it to everyday decisions, confidence, relationships, and personal growth.

posts.name: Trading Desk - Idle
posts.tagline: Incremental game built around growing a trading desk.
posts.description: Trading Desk - Idle: a free browser idle game. Build a portfolio of income-generating assets, unlock the Casino, Real Estate, and a hidden Darknet layer, and watch your net worth grow automatically. Will you control the world ?

posts.name: Changelog Fast
posts.tagline: I was tired of PMs asking "is it in prod yet?"
posts.description: It started with two moments every dev knows: a PM asking "is X live yet?" for the third time this week — and a PM discovering a feature from a customer's bug ticket. changelogfa.st reads your merged PRs and Linear/Jira tickets, then tells every stakeholder what shipped — in their words, on their channel: technical notes for engineers in Slack, plain-English emails for customers, a 3-line recap for your boss. No hype, noise filtered. You just build & ship.

posts.name: GetOperators
posts.tagline: Talent network for AI operators, matched on proof of work
posts.description: GetOperators is a talent network for AI-native operators and agentic engineers - matched to companies by what they've actually shipped (their GitHub and real work), not resumes, leetcode, or whiteboards. 100% remote, always. Two sides: operators find remote work where proof-of-work is the resume; teams hire people who ship. It's early access right now - join the list to be first in when it opens.
